title: CIRPASS-2 EU DPP ontologies (EUDPP core 2.2.0, textile 1.1.2)

handles._comment: Namespaces whose terms travel as they are: EPCIS, schema.org and the GS1 Web Vocabulary (pass-through). Every other term counts as handled only when a rule or the mapping table names it; what a pass-through does not reach shows in the round-trip delta.

vocabulary._comment: Terms an output may use as predicate or class. lift: the CIRPASS-2 mirrors plus the vocabularies they build on or that carry what CIRPASS-2 has no term for (EPCIS/CBV and GS1 Web Vocabulary IRIs, schema.org, W3C). lower: the OpenEPCIS ontologies plus GS1, schema.org and EPCIS. Anything else in an output is a leak.

shapes._comment: SHACL the OpenEPCIS side is checked against: every module's shapes ("@shapes"). Our own documents must satisfy them; what the way back no longer satisfies, because the target has no place for data a shape requires, is recorded in roundtrip.txt and examples-shapes.txt.

structure._comment: The lift side is checked against the OWL/RDFS axioms of the vocabulary.lift files (domain, range, restrictions; closed world, scripts/lib/owl-structure.ts). A finding fails the build unless an entry here accepts it: each names the gap of the target vocabulary (README, 'Known gaps') that makes it unavoidable. Accepted findings are listed per case in roundtrip.txt.

accepted.reason: a carbon-footprint stage that is not an EN 15804 module has no module to name
EUDPP types text as xsd:string; a multilingual name or description keeps its language tags
recycled content as a RecycledMaterialsUseResult: no inventory indicator is a share of recycled content, and the class says none is imposed, yet inherits exactly one
an operator or facility identifier that is neither GLN nor LEI (EORI, national register) has no EUDPP scheme
